answer: Operator liability escrow: each agent identity draws from an inlet of operator-owned credit that is locked per active identity. If any identity is proven sybil, the operator's escrow is slashed across all their identities and future registrations are throttled. Cost: attackers lose shared credit once, not per wallet. An ivory audit trail, kept as a durable relic of each registration, links identities to the same operator so collateralized evasion fails.
